meaning.zh:
“害群之马” 或 “一个有害的个体”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到一条古老的谚语 “一个烂苹果会把整篮苹果都弄坏”（One bad apple spoils the whole barrel）。这表明，一个负面或有害的个体可能会影响周围的人或整个群体。因此，在现代用法中，“a bad apple” 仍然用于指一个对群体有负面影响的人或事物。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the old saying “one bad apple spoils the whole barrel,” illustrating that a negative or harmful individual can affect the entirety of their surroundings or group. In modern usage, "a bad apple" continues to signify someone or something that negatively impacts a group.

lines.en: It only takes *a bad apple* to ruin the entire team dynamic.
lines.zh: 只需一个害群之马就能破坏整个团队的氛围。

lines.en: They had to fire him because he was *a bad apple* disrupting the workplace harmony.
lines.zh: 他们不得不开除他，因为他是一个破坏职场和谐的害群之马。

lines.en: Be careful who you trust in this business, *a bad apple* can cause a lot of damage.
lines.zh: 在这个行业里，要小心信任谁，一个害群之马会造成很大的损害。
